equipment.name: EMS Synthi AKS
equipment.specifications: Portable synthesizer with pin matrix patching, three oscillators, filter, and envelope generator
equipment.usageDescription: Used extensively on "On the Run" to create the driving synthesizer sequence and sound effects. Roger Waters created the main sequence on this portable synth.

equipment.name: Neumann U87 Microphone
equipment.specifications: Large diaphragm condenser microphone with three polar patterns
equipment.usageDescription: Used for recording vocals throughout the album, particularly on "The Great Gig in the Sky" for Clare Torry's voice.
associatedTracks: The Great Gig in the Sky

equipment.name: Abbey Road EMI TG12345 Console
equipment.usageDescription: The main recording console used at Abbey Road Studios during the sessions, providing the distinctive sound of the album.
